name: Tomorrow.io
summary: Tomorrow.io's Weather API: current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts, the last 24 hours of history, and custom timelines of chosen weather fields for a location.

api_key.description: A Tomorrow.io API key (app.tomorrow.io > Development > API keys), sent as the apikey query parameter. Keys carry full account privileges.

notes: location takes 'latitude, longitude' (latitude first, e.g. 42.3478, -71.0466), a city name, a US zip with country (10001 US) or a UK postcode.
Requests per second, hour and day are capped by plan; over the cap answers 429. Remaining-quota headers are sent to Enterprise accounts only.
units is metric (default) or imperial; field meanings and units are in the Weather Data Layers reference.

endpoints.name: Get the weather forecast for a location
endpoints.summary: Hourly forecasts for the next 120 hours and daily forecasts for the next 5 days (minutely on premium plans).

location.description: lat, lon (latitude first), a city name, a US zip with country, or a UK postcode.

endpoints.name: Get current weather for a location
endpoints.summary: Current conditions (temperature, wind, precipitation, cloud cover, weather code...) at a location.

location.description: lat, lon (latitude first), a city name, a US zip with country, or a UK postcode.

endpoints.name: Get the last day of weather history
endpoints.summary: Hourly weather for the last 24 hours and daily weather for the last day at a location.

location.description: lat, lon (latitude first), a city name, a US zip with country, or a UK postcode.

notes: Only the last 24 hours; older history is a separate, token-billed historical API not covered here.

endpoints.name: Get a timeline of chosen weather fields
endpoints.summary: Values of the fields you pick (temperature, precipitationIntensity, windSpeed...) at the timesteps and time window you pick, for a point, a saved location or a GeoJSON geometry.

location.description: lat, lon (latitude first), a saved location id, or a GeoJSON geometry.

startTime.description: now (default), nowPlusXh / nowMinusXh (m, h, d), or ISO 8601.

endTime.description: Same forms as startTime, e.g. nowPlus6h.

timezone.description: Time zone the returned times are shown in; it does not shift startTime and endTime.

dailyStartHour.description: Hour 0-23 at which daily (1d) aggregation starts; default 6.

notes: A read over POST: the body only carries the query (location, fields, window); nothing is saved.
For a polygon or line location, a field without a suffix is the maximum over the area.
